text: Steenbarger: my method sets no day_vol line, so I will not invent one. Its fund-flow test is COM above zero (C28), proxied by subcomponents.flow.cmf, which is not served; day_vol 0.5 is a stated participation caution (R11), not a reject. Timeframe: D. My resistance-line signal needs a close above pivot_high (R13), and close_vs_swing_high_pct -0.86 is not there yet; then a buy over yesterday's high, trailed (C27). So I back close_above:pivot_high on D over the H1 poke. Clears the volume doubt: cmf above zero. Wrong on a daily close under max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d).
